verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice AI phone-call platform, so DTMF, IVR navigation and voicemail handling are a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. The pack covers only pathways, SIP, batch calls, webhooks and tooling, which are adjacent features and do not establish this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
